title: FREE REQUEST Beast Slayer Game - I'm looking peoples for my team dev :)

posts.author: Actias29
posts.body:
Hi guys, I'm Actias, (Real name Kevin), i'm an italian pixel artist since 2020. I writing this thread for ask help to make this big project.
Engine
: RPG Maker MV
Idea
: The game is a Hunt game, basically it is a game that recalls the Monster Hunter series, so you create your character, you create your companion and select the weapon you want to use, you can change it as you like so it is not fixed, some of these they are switchable, like the Spear and shield you can switch it making it become a battle-axe, each equipment remembers the hunted monster obviously the character will have the initial armour, but I have other projects to solve this to give an idea of how the game should be seen equipment. Basically, after creating the character and choosing the weapon you will have to follow the story by hunting the beasts to save the planet's ecosystem from the threat. Although this is an RPG but with a different skill system, there will be many skills based on statistics, and this will be in the armor, for example Elmo Beast 1 can have Bloodlust 2 but Elmo Beast 2 can have other skills, this allows you to create a build that can be suited against the beast or your way of playing.
Position needed
:
MUSIC & SFX (Could be nice if u can do both).
- Musician Manager (
@TriviaHQ
)

SPRITING
- Animation

My role
:
- Spriting (i have over 1000H in RPG Make MV, so know how move in the engine), i asking help cuz between commission and real work i have difficulty to manage all

RPG - Strategy. (Flavor : Fantasy)
